title: feat(sdui-parser): port objectui's one base-prop list into the save gate
body:
Fixes #20578

Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What

Ports objectui's one base-prop list into the save gate, at the console pin `db11afd4967c` (objectui#11008 for `bind`/`hidden`, objectui#11044 for the single list). objectui anchors: `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts:137` (`SDUI_BASE_PROPS`, docblock `:60-136`, skip `:213`) and `packages/sdui-parser/src/codegen.ts:13-32`, `:95-110`.

- `validate.ts`: `BASE_PROPS` is now the `every-node` members of a 20-entry list: the 9 existing plus `bind`, `hidden`, `visibleWhen`, `hiddenOn`, `testId`. Six `where-undeclared` members (`name`, `label`, `description`, `placeholder`, `data`, `ariaLabel`) skip `unknown-prop` only when the type declares no input of that name; a declared one keeps its `type-mismatch` check.
- `codegen.ts`: `generateDts` emitted a hand-kept `export interface SduiBaseProps` (public through `index.ts`). It is now emitted from the same list, and a component that declares a base attribute `Omit`s it from the base it extends. This is the second consumer of the list, so it is exported from `validate.ts` for `codegen.ts` and is not re-exported from `index.ts`.
- Correction: the first revision of this PR (and its report) claimed `codegen.ts` emits no base-props interface. That was false; the second commit fixes the code and the `validate.ts` LOCKSTEP paragraph.
- Existing test `html-tier-manifest.test.ts` now expects `AProps extends Omit<SduiBaseProps, "className">`, the same string objectui pins in `html-tier-manifest-10735.test.ts:114`.

## Clause-② measurement

Scanned every component's `inputs` in the tracked `sdui.manifest.json` (107 components).

- Newly `every-node`: `bind`, `hidden`, `visibleWhen`, `hiddenOn`, `testId` are declared by 0 components each, so no declared type check is removed.
- `where-undeclared`: `name` 3, `label` 10, `description` 6, `data` 7, `placeholder` 0, `ariaLabel` 0 declaring components. The skip is guarded by `!byName.has(key)`, so a declared key takes the same path and severity as before.
- Validator: for this manifest, undeclared uses lose a `unknown-prop` warning; no error-severity `validateTree` diagnostic is removed.
- Generated types: `SduiBaseProps` goes from 8 members to 19, so a `.tsx` page authoring `bind`, `hidden`, `visibleWhen`, `hiddenOn`, `testId`, `name`, `label`, `description`, `placeholder`, `data` or `ariaLabel` on a tag that does not declare it was a TypeScript error against `generateDts` output before and compiles now. That widens the accepted authoring surface and the published type output, hence `yes (widening)` and a `minor` changeset.

## Tests

- New `base-props-one-list.test.ts`: each of the 13 attribute `every-node` members draws no `unknown-prop`; the list is pinned entry by entry (20 entries, `type` alone with no attribute type); each of the 6 `where-undeclared` keys draws nothing when undeclared; a declared `label` given a number still draws `type-mismatch`; a non-base key is still `unknown-prop`; the emitted `SduiBaseProps` equals the list's attribute entries in order; a component with no declared base attribute extends the whole base and one declaring `label` extends `Omit<SduiBaseProps, "label">`. `type` is not tested through `validateTree`: on a node it is the tag itself, so any such case passes through `unknown-component`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/sdui-parser exec vitest run`: 13 files, 224 tests passed; `typecheck` exit 0 (`os-verify-lock`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- No generated `.d.ts` or golden file for this output exists in the repo outside `packages/sdui-parser/` (grep for `SduiBaseProps` and `generateDts`).

## Gates (head `5cb34e77dc`)

`dispatch-gates --commands` derived 61 families; 56 ran and exited 0, including `check:sdui-lockstep`, `check:published-files`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`. NOT MEASURED, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (need a built `dist/`, left to CI): `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:type-check-debt`. The earlier body's count of 52 was wrong.
